title: XOP Aluminum Climbing Sticks for Hunting Treestands - Set of 3

comparisons.notes: XOP's own LMO4 3-pack: 3 sticks, 34-inch total height, 350 lb rating, 6061 aluminum, quarter-turn locking, 3 cam straps. Sale price $99.99, page says in stock, ready to ship.

writeup: This XOP set of three aluminum climbing sticks is $54.99 new at Woot, while XOP's own site sells the same 3-pack for $99.99. The sticks are 6061 aluminum, rated to 350 lb, stack to 34 inches with a quarter-turn lock and come with three cam straps. Woot showed only 1 left with a limit of 3 per customer.
